design: 26 automatically scored held-out families (28 supported, 2 prose excluded, 2 unsupported) x 5 repeats x 2 arms, interleaved in one process
attribution: The model did not issue execute_program on these general tasks: child tool sequences match direct calls (no run made more child calls than model rounds allow). Quality changes (DOC-05 0/5 -> 4/5, OPS-04 3/5 -> 4/5) therefore come from the extra tool in the prompt, not from program execution; they are not evidence that programs improve general tasks.
decision: Generalization gate: enabling PTC on every task is quality-neutral-or-better and safe on this cohort, but costs ~26% more tokens and ~9% more p95 latency without program use. Keep PTC opt-in for paging/aggregation workloads (value gate), never default-on.
limits: Held-out split has 1 Vietnamese/mixed family of 26: language-level conclusions are not supported; a balanced cohort v2 is required
